prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. National cultural heritage travel illustration in the visual style of Day of the Tentacle adventure-game backgrounds with strongly exaggerated wonky angular architecture, crooked perspective and thick dark plum ink contours, combined with sculpted cel-shaded 3D volume, soft cast shadows, ambient occlusion and visible layered depth. NOT a realistic photo. Clear foreground/middle/background separation for parallax shader presentation, atmospheric distant scenery, bold silhouettes and rich organized details. Use real recognizable landmarks from the specified country only, regionally accurate natural animals in separate appropriate habitats. No invented landmark combinations presented as a literal place: this is explicitly a national travel montage. Natural animals without clothes, anthropomorphism or silly expressions. No octopuses, tentacles, fantasy creatures, silly characters or people. No words, lettering, flags, logos, watermarks or national emblems. STRICT EVERYWHERE even tiny skyline: no mosque, minaret, Islamic religious architecture, Islamic symbols, religious crescents, Islamic inscriptions or calligraphy. Civilian background houses only. Authentic Christian churches/cathedrals, Buddhist/Hindu temples, synagogues and ancient sacred monuments ARE allowed and encouraged when significant; do not exclude permitted landmarks merely because religious. Represent listed authentic regional sites without inventing extra religious buildings. Final composition is a broad representative regional selection, never all districts or exhaustive heritage. Keep every primary landmark roof and all animal silhouettes fully inside frame, with margins. Country: Chile. Palette from supplied collection: #97BEEB #B1E9EA #C6B1EF #EFB7DC, supported by muted natural stone, wood and vegetation colors with purple shadows. Show these authentic landmarks in distinct regional clusters: Rapa Nui moai (Easter Island); Torres del Paine (Magallanes); Valparaíso hillside houses (Valparaíso); Chiloé wooden churches (Los Lagos); Humberstone nitrate works (Tarapacá); Atacama salt valley (Antofagasta); Marble Caves (Aysén). Natural animals in appropriate separate habitats: Humboldt penguin on coast, guanaco in Patagonia, Andean condor. Local plants: araucaria, copihue. Small optional authentic craft/food detail: Chiloé woodcraft. Cover panorama3:1 final1500x500. Clear broad region clusters from left to right, animal foreground near lower-right and plants lower-left; ample upper breathing room, mountains and sky far behind.
CRITICAL: THICK dark plum cartoon outlines, crooked angular architecture/rocks, chunky sculpted3D broad pastel facets, no photo textures. Landscape3:1. Chile regional montage; Rapa Nui moai on distinct island, Torres Patagonia peaks, Valparaiso hillside civic houses, Chiloe wooden Christian church standing on solid land (never stilts), Humberstone industrial remains, Atacama salt valley and marble caves. Penguin near coastal lower-right, guanaco Patagonia separate, condor aloft; all animal silhouettes inside generous margins. No extra religious buildings.
